title: Overvaluation of Weight and Shape Intervention vs The Body Project
official: Pilot Testing Overvaluation of Weight and Shape Intervention vs The Body Project
summary: Priorities aims to reduce body image concerns, prevent eating disorders, bolster self-esteem, and promote mental and emotional health by helping participants identify and nurture alternative sources of self-worth. Priorities would use group discussions, role-plays \& behavioral challenges, homework assignments \& letter-writing, and self-worth activism to achieve this. The Priorities intervention will be compared to The Body Project (an existing and successful harm reduction and eating disorder prevention program) for its effectiveness of reducing body image concerns and eating disorder outcomes. This study aims to evaluate whether there is a more effective eating disorder prevention program than The Body Project.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female-identifying
* High School
* College Adolescents
* Ages 14-22

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-female identifying
* Outside of the United States
